summary: Froze the shared-cost allocation contract as a docs-only slice written into project/specs/PH-305.md (per the Lead's BASE correction the whitelist has no docs/adr/ path, so no new ADR file). The contract covers: the shared pool limited to posted cost facts whose ledger scope is nonproject/unallocated (currently PH-217 nonproject/unallocated labor only), explicitly excluding PH-250 one-off fee cost because PH-250 posts it as project-scoped cost (cost posting 200, scope=project) and it is therefore direct project cost that must not be reallocated or double counted (T09); a deterministic pool_key = sha256(org|period|pool_kind|ordered source-ref digest) with mutually exclusive source membership and overlap detection (source_in_multiple_pools); append-only SharedCostAllocationBatch with kind allocation/reversal, allocation draft->posted and reversal draft->posted while the original allocation transitions posted->reversed (status bit only, amounts/detail immutable), a conditional unique effective-positive predicate (kind=allocation AND status=posted AND reversed_by_ref IS NULL) so a posted reversal batch does not collide with the single-effective-batch rule, correction by exact negative mirror of the original detail (no recomputation, reversal batch terminal); driver enum revenue/approved-minutes/direct-cost/fixed weights; integer basis points summing 10000 with ROUND_HALF_UP and last-target residual for positive batches (items >=0, sum==amount) while reversal batches mirror the original items exactly (items <=0, sum==negative amount); no net company cost increase (costing/ledger owner append-only re-scope, no direct ledger edits); read-only reconciliation with frozen issue codes; request_token receipts, org lock, dry_run, period/lock checks; immutable history with reversal+new batch in an open period and algorithm_version; role matrix/history_read; owner boundaries; and the PH-313 write-side relation (no implementation authorization, no canonical topic/command). The report also records the four review blockers fixed after reviewer-b's rejection and the actual pre-review commands at the rebased candidate HEAD with --base c2c76d8.

findings: BLOCKER - pool source contradicts the merged PH-250 fact and the T09 no-double-count invariant: §A lists 公司级手续费成本（PH-250 过账的一次性费用成本） as a company-level pool source, but PH-250 posts the one-off fee as a project-scoped cost (`_post_fee_cost`: LedgerPosting scope_kind='project', scope_id=charge.scope_id; PH-250 spec/golden 'cost posting 200（scope=project）'), and cost aggregation counts scope_kind='project' postings as project cost (costing.services.company_labor_summary: company_cents=all postings, project_cents=scope project). Including that fact in the pool while it remains project cost double counts and breaks §A's '无法直接归属单一项目' premise, its '排除：直接项目成本' list and T09. Fix: keep PH-250 project-scoped fee cost out of the pool and state it remains direct project cost (not reallocated), or freeze an explicit append-only project→pool retraction/re-attribution mechanism with its own planning/migration and explain why it does not double count.

BLOCKER - the correction flow conflicts with the single-effective-batch uniqueness: §B freezes '同 org+period+pool_key 至多一条有效（posted 未冲销）批次' together with '纠错=追加负值冲销批次+新批次', but a posted negative reversal batch is itself 'posted 未冲销' and the batch fields/status only define draft→posted (no reversal kind/status), so after any correction two posted batches share the key and the conditional unique constraint rejects the frozen mechanism; the original batch's 冲销 status transition is also undefined. Fix: add an explicit reversal kind/reversal_of_ref (or reversal status) and define the unique predicate to cover positive not-reversed batches only; state the original batch's allowed status transition keeps amounts immutable.

BLOCKER - §B's per-target rule is unsatisfiable for the frozen negative reversal batch: alloc_i=ROUND_HALF_UP(amount*bp/10000), last target absorbs residual, 'sum(alloc_i)==amount 且每项 ≥0、非负'; with amount<0 (negative reversal) the mirrored allocations are negative, so '每项 ≥0' contradicts the required correction mechanism. Fix: split the rule - positive batch items ≥0; reversal batch items ≤0 and sum==negative amount, mirroring the original target amounts (stable residual rule), and state whether reversal detail mirrors the original targets one-to-one.

BLOCKER - the pool identity/uniqueness key is ambiguous and inconsistent across the frozen artifacts: §A defines the pool identity as org+period+pool_kind+source_refs[], §B freezes uniqueness on org+period+pool_key without defining pool_key, while the report/handoff/verification say '同 org+period+pool_kind 至多一条有效'. That leaves the central one-effective-batch constraint ambiguous (kind-level vs per-source-set pool), and the 'new pool_key' alternative can let two effective batches cover overlapping source facts (double count). Fix: define pool_key deterministically from the identity (e.g. digest of org+period+pool_kind+ordered source_refs) and use it in §A/§B/行为/report consistently; state whether one pool per kind per period or per source-set, and that changed source_refs require reversal+new batch in an open period.
